title: Identification of T follicular helper \(Tfh) cells by flow cytometry
protocol: Prepare single-cell suspensions of murine secondary lymphoid tissues in PBS.
Gently disrupt the tissues between the frosted ends of microscope slides.
Filter cell suspension through fine mesh.
Collect cells in 5ml or 15ml conical tubes.
Optional: Perform red blood cell lysis for spleen samples.
Spin down cells in centrifuge.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in PBS.
Count cells.
Adjust cell numbers with PBS and add ≤3x10^6 cells in 100µl per well of a 96-well round-bottom plate.
Prepare primary antibody 2x mixes in flow buffer in 1.5ml Eppendorf tubes.
Calculate the volume to be added per well of the plate, typically 20µl for a final staining volume of 40µl.
Multiply the number of samples by the volume of the 2x mix needed per sample and add extra void volume if necessary.
Include anti-CXCR5-biotin at a dilution of 1:25 in the 2x mix, with a final dilution of 1:50.
Also prepare compensation control stains as needed.
Keep tubes on ice until use.
Spin tubes in a microcentrifuge for 3 minutes at full speed before use to remove excess protein aggregates.
Use only the supernatant from the centrifuged tubes.
Spin down plate at 700g for 2min.
Discard supernatant by quickly flicking the plate.
Loosen cell pellet by briefly vortexing the plate on full speed with a paper towel on top.
Wash cells with 200µl flow buffer.
For analysis, use flow buffer containing 0.05% sodium azide.
For sorting viable cells, use flow buffer without sodium azide.
Repeat step of spinning down plate at 700g for 2min.
Discard supernatant by quickly flicking the plate.
Loosen cell pellet by briefly vortexing the plate on full speed with a paper towel on top.
Add 20 µl of blocking solution containing 5 µg/ml anti-CD16/32 (Fc-block) and 2% normal mouse serum/2% normal rat serum in flow buffer.
Incubate the solution for 5 minutes on ice.
Add 20 µl of a 2x primary antibody mix on top of the blocking solution without washing between steps.
Incubate for 30-40 minutes on ice.
Add 160 µl of flow buffer and repeat step 8 (adding more flow buffer).
Repeat step 9 (incubating after adding flow buffer).
Add 40 µl of streptavidin-APC at a final concentration of 0.5 µg/ml in flow buffer per well.
Incubate for 15-20 minutes on ice.
Repeat step 8 (adding more flow buffer) and step 9 (incubating after adding flow buffer).
Resuspend cells in flow buffer for subsequent analysis using a flow cytometer or for cell sorting.
Include a viability dye, such as 7-AAD, by resuspending cells in 100 µl of flow buffer and adding 1 µl of 7-AAD.
Following steps 1 through 6, add 100 µl of eFluor780 Fixable Viability Dye diluted at a ratio of 1:1000 in PBS to the cells.
Incubate for 10 minutes on ice.
Prepare Fixation/Permeabilization solution according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Loosen cell pellet and add 100 µl of Fixation/Permeabilization solution per well.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare transcription factor antibody 2x mixes in Permeabilization buffer.
Calculate the volume needed based on the number of samples to be stained, adding 20 µl per sample and 40 µl extra void volume.
Include anti-BLC6-PE antibody at a dilution of 1:25 for the 2x mix.
Keep tubes on ice until needed.
Spin tubes in a microcentrifuge for 3 minutes at full speed before use to remove excess protein aggregates.
Use only the supernatant.
Add 100 µl of permeabilization buffer to the 100 µl of cells per well and spin down.
Wash once with 200 µl of permeabilization buffer.
Loosen cell pellet and add 20 µl of blocking solution containing 5 µg/ml anti-CD16/32 (Fc-block) and 2% normal mouse serum/2% normal rat serum in permeabilization buffer.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 20 µl of 2x transcription factor antibody mixes on top of the blocking solution without washing in between.
Incubate for 30-40 minutes at room temperature.
Wash twice with permeabilization buffer.
Resuspend cells in flow buffer for acquisition on a flow cytometer.
